description: This file contains React functional components and utility functions for rendering activity and usage metrics dashboards, including charts, summaries, and data aggregation logic related to model activity, API keys, and team data.

methods.name: formatKeyLabel
methods.description: Formats and returns a key label, including team alias if available, based on key metadata.

methods.name: processActivityData
methods.description: Processes daily activity results to generate a structured record of model activity metrics, including optional top API key breakdowns.
